prompt: My adult sister asked to move in with us after losing her job. We have two young children and a small apartment. How should I think about saying yes or no?
My spouse wants to relocate for a promotion. I would be leaving my aging parent who lives ten minutes away. How do I weigh this?
My parents keep criticizing how we raise our children whenever they visit. I want the kids to know their grandparents. What should I do?
I found out my brother has been borrowing money from our mother without telling the rest of us, and she is covering for him. Should I confront them?
My partner and I disagree about whether to have a third child. I am content; they feel our family is incomplete. How should we decide?
A cousin wants me to lie to their spouse about where they were last weekend. I like both of them. What is the right response?
My in-laws expect us every holiday, but my own parents are lonely and less able to travel. How should I split the years without becoming a referee?
I am the only sibling who stayed in our hometown. The others want to sell our late father's house quickly. I am not ready. What now?
My teenager wants to stop visiting their other parent because the visits are tense. The court order says otherwise. How should I handle this?
I suspect my spouse is hiding a moderate gambling habit. There is no crisis yet. Do I investigate, wait, or ask directly?
My eight-year-old was caught stealing a small toy from a store. The clerk said to forget it. Should I still make the child return it and apologize?
A teacher wants my child medicated for classroom restlessness. I am uneasy. How should I think about this request?
My child is being excluded from a friend group at school. They want me to call the other parents. Should I intervene?
We can afford a highly competitive private school, or we can stay in our public school and give the difference to relatives in need. How should we choose?
My teen wants a smartphone because 'everyone has one.' I think they are too young. How do I hold a limit without humiliating them?
I overheard my child lying to protect a friend who cheated. They think loyalty requires silence. What should I say?
My child has real athletic talent, but weekend travel sports are consuming our family's Sundays and savings. When is enough enough?
A babysitter we like posted a mocking video of another child. My kid still wants them. Do I keep using this person?
My adolescent says they do not want to be confirmed / bar or bat mitzvah'd / similarly marked, and I had assumed they would. How should a parent respond?
I lost my temper and frightened my child. They say they are fine. What does genuine repair look like here?
My manager asked me to bury an error in a report that would delay a launch and embarrass the team. The error is real. What should I do?
I was offered a job that pays much more but whose product I consider mildly exploitative. My family could use the money. How should I decide?
A colleague takes credit for my work in meetings. They are otherwise kind and are going through a divorce. How should I respond?
I am being promoted into managing friends. One of them is underperforming. How do I do this without cruelty or favoritism?
My workplace is unionizing. I see both the company's constraints and my coworkers' exhaustion. I have a vote. How should I think?
I can finish a grant application honestly, or I can slightly overclaim past results the way competing labs seem to. The lab's jobs are on the line. What should I do?
I accidentally saw a coworker's salary and it is far higher than mine for the same role. Do I raise it, and how?
A vendor offered me tickets to a game after I recommended their contract. Company policy is gray. Should I accept?
I want to leave a stable job to start a small workshop I believe in. We have a mortgage and one income. How do I judge whether this is courage or recklessness?
My team is being asked to work through a religious or family holiday to meet a client deadline I think is artificial. I am the lead. What should I do?
A friend asked me to cosign a loan. I can survive if they default, but it would wipe out my savings. They would take a refusal personally. Advice?
I inherited money I did not earn. Relatives who struggled more than I did received nothing. What are my obligations?
I found a wallet with a large amount of cash and an ID. Nobody saw me pick it up. What should I do, and why not keep a 'finder's fee'?
Our church or community group wants a flashy renovation. I would rather the money go to people behind on rent. I am on the board. How should I vote and speak?
I can pay off my student loans early or keep them and give more each year to people in deeper trouble. Which is the more responsible path?
A tenant lost their job and is two months behind. I need the rent to cover my own loan. Do I evict, reduce rent, or wait?
I overcharged a client by mistake months ago. They never noticed. The company would not want me to reopen it. What should I do?
My partner secretly opened a new credit card during a spending freeze we agreed on. Trust is damaged. How do we repair both the money and the promise?
I can buy a reliable used car or a status car that would impress clients in my line of work. How should I think about this?
A sibling wants me to invest in their business. The plan is weak. Saying no may end the relationship. What is owed here?
I have a serious diagnosis. My family wants me to fight with every experimental treatment. I am tired and leaning toward palliative care. How do I decide?
My parent with dementia keeps asking to go 'home' to a house we sold. Do I keep re-explaining the truth, or comfort them with a kinder story?
A friend is refusing medical care for a treatable condition because of something they read online. How far may I push?
I am a nurse asked to stay for a double shift again. If I leave, the floor is unsafe. If I stay, I will be unsafe driving home. What should I do?
I need a scarce specialist appointment. I know someone who could get me moved up the list. Other people have waited longer. Should I use the favor?
My spouse wants me to hide a new chronic illness from our adult children 'so they don't worry.' I hate the secrecy. What is kind here?
I struggle with depression and missed a lot of work. My boss is sympathetic but the team is covering for me. When do I step back from the role?
A relative wants me to pray for a miracle instead of consenting to surgery. I am not sure what I believe. How should I respond in the hospital room?
I can donate a kidney to a friend. The risk to me is small but real, and I have young children. How should I think?
Pain medication is the only thing that lets me work, and I can feel dependence forming. My doctor is not worried yet. What should I do?
It has been a year since my spouse died. Friends want me to 'get back out there.' I am not ready, and I also fear becoming stuck. How do I listen to both facts?
My sibling wants a large, expensive funeral. I think our parent would have hated the show and wanted the money given away. We must decide this week.
I feel relief as well as grief after a long caregiving season ended in death. The relief makes me ashamed. What should I do with that feeling?
A coworker who barely knew the deceased is performing very public grief on social media. It bothers me. Should I say anything?
My child keeps asking if the family pet 'went to heaven.' I am unsure of my own answer. What is honest and not crushing?
I was not invited to a funeral of someone I loved, because of an old family fight. Do I go anyway, send a letter, or stay away?
Anniversaries of a loss wreck me, and my new partner feels shut out. How do I keep faith with the dead without abandoning the living?
Someone at the wake told a flattering lie about the person who died. I knew the harder truth. Do I correct it?
I want to keep my parent's room unchanged. The rest of the household needs the space. How do we move at a human pace?
A friend whose child died seems to want me to disappear because my children are a reminder. I also do not want to abandon them. What does accompaniment look like?
My closest friend is becoming cruel when they drink. They deny it. Do I withdraw, issue an ultimatum, or keep showing up?
I was asked to be a groomsman for someone I no longer respect after how they treated an ex. Refusing will explode the friend group. What should I do?
Two friends are in a dispute and each wants me as a witness that they are in the right. I saw both of them behave badly. How do I speak?
A friend constantly vents but never asks how I am. I feel used. Is it small to pull back?
I discovered that a friend has been reading their teenager's private messages. They want my approval as 'safety.' What should I say?
Someone I drifted from is now famous and reaching out. I cannot tell if they want friendship or a useful old name. How do I proceed?
I borrowed a friend's cabin and damaged something expensive. They have not noticed. Repair would be costly. What do I owe?
My friend is entering a relationship I think is harmful. They asked whether I 'support them.' What does support mean if I do not support the match?
A former friend apologized years later for a real betrayal. I am not sure I can trust them again. Must I reconcile to be a decent person?
I am tired of a group chat that gossips about whoever is absent. Leaving will mark me as self-righteous. Staying makes me complicit. Help.
A dying relative asked me whether I think they were a good parent. The honest answer is mixed. What should I say at the bedside?
I know a rumor about a job candidate is false, but it would help my friend get the role if I stay quiet. The hiring committee asked if I 'knew anything concerning.' What do I say?
My child asked if I ever did the thing I am now forbidding. I did, at their age. Do I tell the whole story?
I maintain a cheerful public story about my marriage, but we are barely speaking. Friends keep calling us a model couple. Should I stop performing?
A student asked me, as a teacher, whether their work is actually good. It is not, and a kind lie would help their confidence this week. What is my duty?
I can write a recommendation letter that is technically true but omits a serious character problem. The person needs the job. What should I do?
Someone asked for feedback on their art, and they cannot bear honesty. I am the only person they trust. How do I speak?
I work in communications. Leadership wants a statement that is not false, but is designed to prevent people from understanding what happened. Should I write it?
I no longer believe some of the claims my community treats as identity. If I say so, I may lose my people. If I stay silent, I feel like a coward. How should I live?
A journalist asked me for a quote. A sharper, slightly unfair version would help a cause I care about. The milder true version will be ignored. What do I give them?
I saw a neighbor's child vandalize a parked car. If I tell, the child may be harshly punished. If I don't, the owner bears the cost. What should I do?
A local ordinance would help my property value and push out poorer tenants next door. I get a vote at the meeting tonight. How should I vote?
I am on a jury. The law and the evidence point one way; my sympathy points another. What does integrity look like in the jury room?
My city wants to put a shelter on my block. I believe in the shelter and also fear for my kids' walk to school. How do I participate without NIMBY hypocrisy?
A police officer was rude to me in a traffic stop that was otherwise lawful. I can file a complaint that may go nowhere or may harm a decent person having a bad day. Should I?
I can vote for a candidate whose private life I find contemptible but whose policies I think will prevent real harm. Is character a luxury here?
My workplace asked employees to share a public political statement. I disagree with parts of it but fear being marked as disloyal. What should I do?
I witnessed a shoplifter who looked desperate, not professional. Store policy is to report. I am the shift lead. What should I do?
A whistleblower in my agency asked me to leak documents. The public deserves to know; people I work with would be destroyed. How do I think?
I benefit from a tax loophole that is legal and, I think, unfair. Using it funds my child's tuition. Must I forgo it?
I keep promising to stop scrolling late at night, and I keep failing. It is hurting my work and my patience with my family. How do I actually change?
I drink just enough that nobody would call me an alcoholic, and just enough that I am worse every evening. Do I owe anyone a full stop?
Gambling apps have started to feel like the only rest I get. I have not blown the rent yet. Is this already a moral problem?
I use Adderall that was prescribed to a friend, only on deadline weeks. It works. Is this cheating, medicine, or both?
I cannot seem to keep a simple morning prayer or meditation practice, and I feel fraudulent talking about meaning. Should I stop talking or start smaller?
Pornography is private, free, and making me less present with my partner. They have not asked. What do I owe?
I rage-eat when I am ashamed of my job performance. Diet talk has not helped. What would a deeper change even be?
I am addicted to being needed — I volunteer for everything and then resent people. How do I step back without making it about my virtue?
My phone is the last thing I see at night and the first in the morning. I feel owned. What is a sane rule of life for attention?
I keep restarting self-improvement plans on Mondays and abandoning them by Wednesday. How do I become the kind of person who finishes?
My university wants me to report a classmate for an honor-code violation I only partly saw. If I am wrong, I ruin them. If I am right and silent, the curve hurts others. What should I do?
I can get into a more prestigious program by emphasizing a hardship story that is true but that I would rather keep private. Should I use it?
A student asked me to inflate a grade so they can keep a scholarship. Their family situation is severe. I am the instructor. What is just?
My child used AI to write an essay. The school has no clear policy. They say everyone does it. How should I respond as a parent?
I am on a hiring committee. One candidate is slightly less qualified and would add a kind of diversity our students have never had. How should I weigh this?
A mentor I needed used me as unpaid labor for years. Now they want a glowing tribute at retirement. What do I owe the truth versus peace?
I no longer think my dissertation topic matters, but walking away wastes other people's funding. Do I finish something I judge empty?
A teenager I tutor asked whether college is worth it, given their family's debt. The honest market answer is mixed. What counsel is responsible?
I caught myself padding a CV with a 'forthcoming' paper that is not forthcoming. Nobody has checked. Do I correct a document already submitted?
My department wants to drop a difficult required course because students hate it and enrollments pay the bills. I think the course is the actual education. How do I argue?
My father should not be driving. Taking the keys will crush his last independence. A crash would be on my conscience. How do I act?
We need to choose a nursing home. The nicer one would exhaust our savings in three years; the adequate one is grim. What is love in this choice?
I am seventy and my children want me to move in 'for safety.' I would lose my garden, neighbors, and the feeling of being a person. How should I decide?
A parent keeps giving large gifts to a charismatic advisor. They are competent enough that a lawyer might not call it incapacity. What may an adult child do?
I promised my spouse I would never put them in a home. Their needs now exceed what I can safely provide. Does the promise still bind?
I am becoming slower at a job I love. Nobody has asked me to retire. Do I wait to be told, or step aside for someone younger?
My mother wants me to hear the same stories every visit. I feel myself going numb. How do I stay present without pretending?
I have more years behind me than ahead, and I cannot tell whether to spend savings on a last adventure or hold them for medical unknowns. How should I think?
A widow in our building is isolated and a little difficult. Visiting her is dreary and I think it matters. How much of my week does this claim?
I want to write letters to my grandchildren about the mistakes I hope they will not repeat. My children say I will sound controlling. Should I still write?
I can be reachable to my team at all hours, and it has become expected. My family is paying. Where is the line between diligence and being owned?
I moderate an online community. A charismatic member is unkind in ways that never quite break the rules. Removing them will cause a revolt. What should I do?
I promised myself a device-free dinner, then used a 'quick check' as a reward after a hard day. This is the third week. What would integrity look like tonight?
My job is to maximize engagement. I know the tricks that make people anxious enough to stay. I also have rent. How do I live with this?
A stranger filmed me having a panic attack in public and the clip is spreading. They say it 'raises awareness.' What may I demand?
I keep comparing my interior life to other people's highlight reels and then calling myself ungrateful. How do I get free without becoming smug about 'touching grass'?
My partner wants our child's life fully documented online. I think a child cannot consent to an audience. How do we resolve this before the next birthday?
I use noise and podcasts to avoid being alone with my thoughts. It works. Is that a problem, or a tool?
A viral outrage is probably overstated, but staying silent in my circle looks like complicity. I have not had time to understand it. What should I do today?
I want a Sabbath I do not even know how to name — a day that is not productive. My industry treats that as failure. How do I begin anyway?
New people arrived in our congregation or club and the old-timers, including me, feel displaced. They also bring energy we need. How should I act at the next meeting?
We are choosing a leader. One candidate is competent and cold; the other is warm and sloppy with money. Which failure is more dangerous here?
Someone in our mutual-aid group is taking more than they need. Public accusation would shame them; silence trains everyone to cheat. What is the fitting response?
I have gifts that the group wants to use until I am empty. Saying no feels selfish. How do I refuse without abandoning the work?
A community rule I once supported is now hurting a family I love. Changing it looks like favoritism. Keeping it looks heartless. How should I argue?
We can spend limited funds on a beautiful shared space or on unglamorous leak repair. People will only donate for the beautiful thing. What should the board do?
I am new in town and lonely. The easiest community is organized around beliefs I do not share. May I join for the friendship if I stay quiet?
A volunteer I supervise is kind, unreliable, and elderly. Replacing them would hurt them and help the people we serve. What should I do?
Our group wants to make a public statement on a contested issue. I think we should do our work and speak less. They think silence is a statement. Help me think.
I know the charismatic founder of our nonprofit is exhausting staff. Board members like the founder's story. I am staff. How do I raise this without becoming the villain?
Someone who harmed me as a child now wants a relationship and is not offering a full account of what they did. What do I owe them, if anything?
I want to forgive, but every family dinner reopens the wound. Is avoiding the person allowed, or is that just unforgiveness with better manners?
A coworker apologized in a way that seemed designed to make me look ungracious if I stay angry. The harm was real. How do I respond?
I am the one who did the harm. The other person says they forgive me and still flinches. What does making amends look like when words are cheap?
My sibling will not apologize and does not think they were wrong. Our parents want a 'normal Thanksgiving.' Must I sit at that table?
I keep rehearsing a humiliation from years ago. The other person has moved on. How do I put the knife down without calling that cheap positivity?
A public figure hurt people like me and is now doing a redemption tour. My friends want me to 'let people grow.' I think they want applause. How should I relate to this?
I promised myself I would never speak to a former friend. Now they are in genuine trouble and I am in a position to help quietly. Does the old vow still hold?
My partner wants us to get even with a landlord who cheated us. The law would be slow; a bad review campaign would be fast. What should we do?
I cannot tell whether I have actually forgiven someone or merely gone numb. What would a trustworthy test look like in ordinary life?
